description: This file is a source code implementation for the CUDA module in PyTorch, containing definitions and bindings for CUDA device management, memory management, stream handling, version info, and other CUDA related functionalities in the PyTorch C++ backend.

classes.name: _CudaDeviceProperties
classes.description: Represents properties of a CUDA device, exposing various hardware attributes such as name, memory, compute capability, etc.

classes.name: _CUuuid
classes.description: Represents the UUID of a CUDA device, with a method to access its byte representation.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_setDevice_wrap(PyObject * self,PyObject * arg)
methods.description: Wraps the set device function for Python, setting the current CUDA device.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_exchangeDevice(PyObject * self,PyObject * arg)
methods.description: Exchange the current CUDA device with a specified device index.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_getDevice_wrap(PyObject * self,PyObject * noargs)
methods.description: Returns the current CUDA device index.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_canDeviceAccessPeer_wrap(PyObject * self,PyObject * args)
methods.description: Checks whether a device can access its peer device.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_getDeviceCount_wrap(PyObject * self,PyObject * noargs)
methods.description: Returns the total count of CUDA devices available.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_getArchFlags(PyObject * self,PyObject * noargs)
methods.description: Returns CUDA architecture flags if available.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_isInBadFork(PyObject * self,PyObject * noargs)
methods.description: Checks whether the current process is in a bad fork state for CUDA.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_getCurrentStream_wrap(PyObject *,PyObject * device_index)
methods.description: Returns the current CUDA stream's id, device index, and device type as a tuple.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_getCurrentStream_raw(PyObject *,PyObject * device_index)
methods.description: Returns the raw pointer to the current CUDA stream.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_getDefaultStream_wrap(PyObject *,PyObject * device_index)
methods.description: Returns the default CUDA stream's id, device index, and device type as a tuple.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_setStream_wrap(PyObject * self,PyObject * args,PyObject * kwargs)
methods.description: Sets the current CUDA stream based on stream id, device index, and device type.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_getCompiledVersion(PyObject * self,PyObject * noargs)
methods.description: Returns the version of the CUDA compiler or ROCM if applicable.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_getHipblasltVersion(PyObject * self,PyObject * noargs)
methods.description: Returns the HipBLASLt version if applicable.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_cudaCachingAllocator_raw_alloc(PyObject * _unused,PyObject * args)
methods.description: Allocates memory on the CUDA device through the caching allocator using a specified stream.

methods.name: as_scalar
methods.description: Converts a PyObject to an at::Scalar, with support for tensors, numbers, and booleans.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_cudaJiteratorCompileAndLaunchKernel(PyObject * _unused,PyObject * args)
methods.description: Compiles and launches a CUDA kernel given code string, kernel name, tensors, and other parameters.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_cudaCachingAllocator_raw_delete(PyObject * _unused,PyObject * obj)
methods.description: Frees device memory allocated through the caching allocator.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_cudaCachingAllocator_enable(PyObject * _unused,PyObject * arg)
methods.description: Enables or disables the CUDA caching allocator.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_getAllocatorBackend(PyObject * _unused,PyObject * noargs)
methods.description: Returns the name of the current allocator backend.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_cudaSynchronize(PyObject * _unused,PyObject * noargs)
methods.description: Synchronizes the CUDA device, waiting for all preceding tasks to complete.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_cudaSleep(PyObject * _unused,PyObject * cycles)
methods.description: Sleeps on the CUDA device for a specified number of cycles.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_cudaLockMutex(PyObject * module,PyObject * noargs)
methods.description: Locks the CUDA mutex to ensure exclusive access, preventing deadlocks during memory operations.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_hasPrimaryContext(PyObject * _unused,PyObject * arg)
methods.description: Checks whether the given device has a primary context.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_getMemoryFraction(PyObject * _unused,PyObject * args)
methods.description: Gets the fraction of memory used for CUDA memory cache.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_setMemoryFraction(PyObject * _unused,PyObject * args)
methods.description: Sets the fraction of memory to be used for CUDA memory cache.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_hostEmptyCache(PyObject * _unused,PyObject * noargs)
methods.description: Empties the host CUDA memory cache.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_memoryStats(PyObject * _unused,PyObject * arg)
methods.description: Provides memory statistics for a given CUDA device.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_resetPeakHostMemoryStats(PyObject * _unused,PyObject * noargs)
methods.description: Resets the peak host memory statistics.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_memorySnapshot(PyObject * _unused,PyObject * arg)
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of CUDA memory allocations and segments.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_attachOutOfMemoryObserver(PyObject * _unused,PyObject * observer)
methods.description: Attaches an observer callback for out-of-memory events.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_cudaSetSyncDebugMode(PyObject * _unused,PyObject * arg)
methods.description: Sets the debugging mode for CUDA synchronization.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_cudaGetSyncDebugMode(PyObject * self,PyObject * noargs)
methods.description: Gets the current debugging mode for CUDA synchronization.

methods.name: registerCudaDeviceProperties
methods.description: Registers the CUDA device properties class with the module.

methods.name: PyObject * THCPModule_initExtension(PyObject * self,PyObject * noargs)
methods.description: Initializes the CUDA extension, setting up classes and default state.

ctags.name: FreeFuncType
ctags.pattern: /^    using FreeFuncType = void(void*, size_t, int, cudaStream_t);$/
